_doc: The World Government and Marine hierarchy. LADDERED (2026-08-22): tiers AND members are rung-stacks — the reader sees the hierarchy as it looked at THEIR chapter. A tier can change its own name and summary ('The Five Elders' is the apex of the world a Ch. 300 reader knows; 'Government Apex' with Imu above them is a Ch. 908 truth). Members appear when the reader learns they BELONG here, not at debut — Kalifa and Blueno being CP9 is the Water 7 twist itself (Ch. 347), Vergo's Vice-Admiral entry is clean until Ch. 673 makes him a mole. Maintainer QA flags are in _qa_flags.
_qa_flags: Nerona-D: the previous data said 'D. status confirmed' but will-of-d.json lists Nerona D. Imu as NOT confirmed. Rung text currently stops at the family name (1086). If a late chapter (1140s+?) confirmed the D., supply the chapter + wording.
Nusjuro: previous data said he 'wields the legendary blade Shimotsuki'. Chapter for that name-drop needed before it goes in a rung.
Imu 1189-1191 new-form rung: needs maintainer wording (same as void-century).
Uncertain chapters marked in rung notes: Tsuru 556, Momonga 508, Kong 594, Stussy-CP0 892, Coby-SWORD 1061, Saturn-immortality 1110, Onigumo-fruit 1111.

rungs.label: The Five Elders
rungs.summary: The highest publicly known authority of the World Government — five old men above even the Fleet Admiral.

rungs.label: Government Apex
rungs.summary: Beyond the Marines — the true rulers of the world. And above the Five Elders sits something the world was never told about.

rungs.note: The Reverie showed it: the Empty Throne is occupied, and the Five Elders kneel to its occupant. To the world, the throne is still empty.
Hidden ruler of the world. Erased Lulusia on a word; spoke the name 'Lili' to King Cobra before his death. Family name: Nerona.
Five unnamed old men who steer the World Government from Mariejois. Even the Fleet Admiral answers to them.
Five old men who steer the World Government — and who were just seen kneeling to someone the world does not know exists.
Warrior God of Science and Defence.
Warrior God of Science and Defence. His true form — a monstrous spider-ox — walked onto Egghead in person.
Warrior God of Environment.
Warrior God of Environment. True form: the Itsumade bird.
Warrior God of Justice.
Warrior God of Justice. True form: the boar demon Fengxi.
Warrior God of Finance. Carries a katana at all times.
Warrior God of Finance. True form: the sabre-toothed bakotsu — a skeletal horse-demon on the battlefield.
Warrior God of Agriculture.
Warrior God of Agriculture. True form: the sandworm.

rungs.label: Fleet Admiral
rungs.summary: Supreme commander of the Marines, answering only to the Five Elders.

rungs.note: 'Sengoku the Buddha' — supreme commander of the Marines.
Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Daibutsu — the Buddha epithet was literal.
Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Daibutsu. Stepped down after the war; now Inspector General.
Magu Magu no Mi (magma). Hard-line Absolute Justice. Took the post after beating Kuzan for it.
Fleet Admiral of Roger's era; stepped up to World Government Commander-in-Chief. (QA: chapter approximate)

rungs.label: Admirals
rungs.summary: The Marines' top-tier combatants — the Government's greatest military force.

rungs.note: Hie Hie no Mi (ice). Wanders where he pleases; froze the sea to visit the Straw Hats personally.
Hie Hie no Mi (ice). Lost the Fleet Admiral post to Sakazuki after a ten-day duel, and left the Marines.
Hie Hie no Mi (ice). Left the Marines after losing the top post — and has since been seen moving with the Blackbeard Pirates.
Pika Pika no Mi (light). Unsettlingly casual about everything, including violence.
The admiral who ordered the evacuation ship destroyed at Ohara. Absolute Justice at its most absolute.
Promoted to Fleet Admiral after defeating Kuzan.
Gravity blade (Zushi Zushi no Mi). Blinded himself long ago rather than see the world's ugliness. Post-timeskip recruit.
The other post-timeskip admiral. Hasn't eaten in years, apparently.
Mori Mori no Mi (forest). Flew to Wano uninvited and got a lesson in why you knock.

rungs.label: Vice Admirals
rungs.summary: Senior Marine officers — most carry powerful Devil Fruits or proven Haki.

rungs.role: Vice Admiral / Hero of the Marines
rungs.note: The Marine who cornered Roger, again and again.

rungs.role: Vice Admiral / Hero of the Marines
rungs.note: Roger's lifelong rival. Luffy's grandfather. Trains promising rookies with cannonballs.
Woshu Woshu no Mi — washes pirates clean, literally. (QA: chapter approximate)
Moku Moku no Mi (smoke). The first Marine Luffy couldn't hit.
Moku Moku no Mi (smoke). Promoted after the war; requested the G-5 madhouse on purpose.
Led the escort to Impel Down; stabbed his own hand to break Hancock's charm. (QA: chapter approximate)
Six-armed Vice Admiral of the Marineford line.
Kumo Kumo no Mi, Model: Rosamygale Grauvogeli — an ancient spider Zoan. The six arms weren't a costume. (QA: chapter approximate)
Tall, distinctive helmet. Marineford veteran.
'Shark-Cutter' Bastille — mask, greatsword, Dressrosa command.
Base commander of G-5, respected by his men.
Doflamingo's mole inside the Marines since childhood — the reason Law never trusted a uniform.
Doflamingo's mole. Killed by Law on Punk Hazard, bisected with the facility.
Egghead-era Vice Admiral; commands the SWORD unit.

rungs.label: Cipher Pol Aigis Zero (CP0)
rungs.summary: The World Government's most secret intelligence and assassination unit. Operates above Marine command. White coats, faceless masks.

rungs.note: The strongest killer CP9 ever produced now wears the white mask.
Awakened Neko Neko no Mi, Model: Leopard. Sent to Egghead to erase Vegapunk.
Ushi Ushi no Mi, Model: Giraffe. The square-nosed swordsman followed Lucci into the white.
Moved through the underworld as the 'Queen of the Pleasure District' — and answered to the Government all along. (QA: chapter approximate)
A clone of Miss Buckingham Stussy, made in Vegapunk's MADS era — and she chose to turn on her handlers at Egghead.
The Enies Lobby villain survived his own failure and clings on under CP0.

rungs.label: Cipher Pol 9 (CP9)
rungs.summary: The Government's assassination unit that hid in plain sight at Water 7 for five years.

rungs.label: Cipher Pol 9 (CP9)
rungs.summary: The Government's assassination unit that hid in plain sight at Water 7. Disbanded after Enies Lobby; its best moved up to CP0.

rungs.note: The quiet dock-worker was the Government's deadliest assassin.
Galley-La's best inspector, and a Government blade.
Iceburg's secretary was the Government's plant. Awa Awa no Mi (bubbles), acquired at Enies Lobby.
Poured drinks in Water 7 for five years. Doa Doa no Mi (door).
Inu Inu no Mi, Model: Wolf. Loudest man on Enies Lobby.
Iron Body specialist who cannot keep a secret despite the zip.
Kabuki melodrama and prehensile hair.
Commanded the strongest CP9 in history and still lost everything at Enies Lobby.

rungs.label: SWORD
rungs.summary: A secret Marine cell operating outside the formal chain of command — members can resign on paper while staying active.

rungs.note: The Supernova inside the Beasts Pirates was a Marine plant all along.
The chore-boy from Alvida's ship now captains the Marines' secret cell. (QA: chapter approximate)
Promoted from Marineford rookie to SWORD captain — and walked out of Blackbeard's Hachinosu a hero.
Garp's other protégé. Coby's partner since the very first arc.
Sniper on the Coby-rescue mission.
Egghead-era member.
The Vice Admiral who leads the unit.

rungs.label: Marine Branch Captains & Special
rungs.summary: Captains, instructors, base commanders, and special-operations leads.

rungs.note: Sword collector on a mission to take meito out of criminal hands.
Smoker's right hand at the G-5 madhouse. Sword collector.
'Black Cage' Hina — Ori Ori no Mi. Smoker's old academy classmate.
'Ship-Cutter' T-Bone — terrifying face, gentlest heart on the sea train line.
Axe, attitude, and the tightest lips in the Marines.
